summary: American Homes 4 Rent filed an 8-K reporting the replacement of its expiring Form S-3 shelf registration statement with a new one, and concurrently entered into a new at-the-market offering (ATM) program. Under the Sales Agreement with multiple agents and forward sellers/purchasers, the company may issue up to $1.0 billion of Class A common shares from time to time in at-the-market transactions. This is a routine capital markets activity, not a special situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is involved.
